independent_reviewer: ChatGPT (via Frank-as-relay per new operating model)

withheld_until_freeze.expected_sha256_content: entire-directory-tree-hash-not-applicable; verify file-by-file against 02-development-transcript/README.md recorded SHA-256 16651893e987456acaf15cd7ddfbdd146b2277d4ed4533c7a714894e93537ea8 for receipt_organizer_transcript.txt

target_environment.session_lifecycle: fresh --session-id <uuid> at reconstruction turn; --resume <uuid> for tests T1-T5 and generalization G

capture_discipline_v02.rationale: Per AB replication-005 finding, capture via shell redirect (not tee+head) eliminates SIGPIPE truncation. Per-turn verification gate: jq empty && size>1KB && size%8192!=0 && sha256sum.

freeze_discipline_v02.rationale: Per AB replication-006 finding, transcript-only reconstruction can fail freeze if the target echoes any imperative phrases from the historical artifact set. This is an artifact-only run (no transcript), so the freeze risk is lower, but the same gate is applied for consistency.
freeze_discipline_v02.ready_line_format: Single line containing exactly `READY` + brief self-description (e.g., 'READY — Receipt Organizer pinned; ledger empty.').
verification_gate_order: READY keyword present in reconstruction turn
failing gate defaults BLOCKED; no re-issue for freeze per v0.2 §rule 4

test_sequence.expected: READY statement; no tool_use; no prohibited phrases

test_sequence.critical_requirement: Tip outside printed total acknowledged, not folded into total
Threshold query returns only strictly-over-$50 receipts

test_sequence.action: 'How much did I spend on restaurants?'
test_sequence.critical_requirement: Category aggregate correct over full ingested corpus

test_sequence.action: paste Target; ask 'What did I spend at Target?'
test_sequence.critical_requirement: Retail classification; correct query answer; ledger count incremented

state_retention_requirement.rationale: Receipt Organizer is stateful. The reconstructing environment must retain the ledger across turns within the same conversation.
state_retention_requirement.verification: After each test turn, operator records the ledger state as reported by the target. If the ledger is empty or reset between turns, this is recorded as environment-state-loss failure (not behavioral failure) per the experimental protocol.
state_retention_requirement.mitigation_if_state_lost: Try a different environment (e.g., a different model that retains conversation memory) before concluding the baseline is unrecoverable.

overall_classification.PARTIAL: at least 3 tests PASS, no test FAIL
overall_classification.FAIL: any test FAIL, or fewer than 3 PASS

out_of_scope: implementation-freedom variation (initial run uses same conversational mechanism as development session)
